finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
finding.summary: The CGI 'subject' parameter is read unsanitized in ticket_controller.pl, wrapped into a TicketSummary object in TicketSummary.pm, and rendered with raw string interpolation via say() in TicketPageRenderer.pm, giving a reflected XSS that crosses all 3 files.
